issues: Rate-limit error 'Too many attempts' remains visible on login screen but the input still accepts new PIN — acceptable but could auto-clear after 60s window.

critical_code_review_comments: truck_cleaning_crew.py:198 — rate-limit is per-IP for /crew/login only; note it is also applied to POST /public/booking (line 619) which shares the same key namespace `tc-crew-login:{ip}` — a genuine visitor spamming login could accidentally block their own /wash booking submission. Consider separate keys.
truck_cleaning_crew.py:210 — locked_until check compares ISO strings; correct because timestamps are UTC ISO-8601 fixed format, but risky if timezone offsets ever change. Consider parsing datetimes.

truck_cleaning_crew.py:404-405 — 'Upsell not checked: …' is emitted as a blocker for optional upsells; per problem statement all checklist items (core + upsell) must be done. Confirm this is intentional — it forces techs to check upsell tasks even if the customer declined at completion time.
truck_cleaning_crew.py:438 — asyncio.create_task fire-and-forget for AI note — no exception is re-raised; fine but a warning log would help diagnose LLM failures.
File truck_cleaning_crew.py is 673 lines, close to the 700-line threshold. Consider splitting (auth/clock/jobs/money/vehicles/public) into sub-modules soon.
